Cozy, calm, great coffee
Nov 2018 • Couples
Hip coffee shop, tucked away in an alley in japantown. The americano tasted as an americano should, given good beans and a great barista, a lot of bean taste and a delightful drink.

We also had passionfruit cheesecake, which was good but not splendid.

This is a good hideout if you want calmness in a city with a lively and sometimes crazy pulse.
